name: Vegetable Biryani
subtitle: layered rice and mixed vegetables sealed and steamed, the meatless dum biryani

ingredients.qty: a pinch in 3 tbsp warm milk

prepNotes: Vegetables release water in a way meat does not, so they are fried hard first. Raw vegetables layered under rice make it soggy.
Cook the rice to 70 per cent only. It finishes in the steam of the sealed pot.

steps.text: Fry the sliced onion in ghee until deep brown and crisp. Drain and reserve; this birista carries the sweetness of the dish.
steps.tip: Pull them out a shade lighter than you want, they darken as they cool.

steps.text: Fry the potato, cauliflower, carrot and beans in the same ghee over high heat until the edges colour. Do not cook them through.
Fold the vegetables into the whisked yogurt with ginger, garlic, chilli, turmeric, half the herbs, half the birista and salt. Rest 20 minutes.
Boil the rice in heavily salted water with the whole spices until 70 per cent done, about 5 minutes, then drain at once.
steps.tip: Test by crushing a grain: it should still have a hard white core.

steps.text: Spread the vegetable mixture in a heavy pot, layer the rice over it, and top with the remaining birista, herbs, saffron milk, lemon juice and ghee.
Seal with a tight lid or foil. Cook 5 minutes on high to build steam, then 25 minutes on the lowest heat.
Rest 15 minutes before opening. Lift from the bottom to serve so every plate gets both layers.

storage: Keeps 2 days refrigerated. Reheat covered with a sprinkle of water; the microwave dries the top layer. Do not freeze, the vegetables collapse.

nutrition.method: Estimated from raw ingredients using USDA FoodData Central. Cooking losses are not modelled and added salt is excluded, so sodium is not given.
